commits.body: The skill at 0.10.0 and the repository it runs on, pinned to each other: plugins/in-the-loop/skills/prove-java-change/release.json records the sha256 digest of this commit's tree (edd95d299add28cb690fc8a22e116b3a30dc1c22232239623722d76a678b5674, 5536 files; the pin and the generated trace files are left out), and the skill's bootstrap accepts only a commit that hashes to it. Cut with llm-dlc/tools/release.py cut, which verified the commit afterwards. Summaries every 30 minutes (--summary-interval), --unattended, --record-as, the model may start the skill, watch.py loop passes its options in order, and the verification queue is worked together: a queued job is announced by its commit and starts beside the jobs running
